scoring_justification: Checker recomputes total magnetic moment per formula unit from atomic_moments.csv and band gap from dos_data.csv, comparing to paper-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold target values for total magnetic moment per formula unit (0.03125 μB/f.u.) and band gap (0.047 eV)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 0.03125 μB/f.u. from integrated DOS, 0.047 eV from computed band structures
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual computed results that the reproduction should match within tolerance

outputs.description: Per-atom magnetic moments from the spin-polarized DFT calculation. The checker will recompute the total magnetic moment and check delocalization.
Agent-reported total magnetic moment per formula unit (μ_B/f.u.). The checker compares it to the value recomputed from atomic_moments.csv.
Spin-resolved total density of states over [-5,5] eV around the Fermi level. The checker recomputes the band gap from this data.
Agent-reported band gap in eV. The checker compares it to the value recomputed from dos_data.csv.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the total magnetic moment from atomic_moments.csv by summing all atomic moments and dividing by 32, then compares against the paper's reported value. It also verifies that all atomic moments are below 0.01 μ_B (delocalization). The band gap is recomputed from dos_data.csv as the difference between the highest occupied and lowest unoccupied states across both spin channels and compared against the paper's reported gap. Both comparisons use appropriate tolerances.
